description.value:
Duration constant

Retained by the Combine specifically because the alternative was a demolition crew and three days.

Your Strikes against objects, structures, vehicles, and barriers deal double damage and ignore Hardness entirely. Against constructs and creatures made of worked stone, metal, or machinery, you ignore 5 points of any resistance and treat their Hardness, if any, as 0.

cinderfall.incomplete: The damage-doubling-vs-objects clause reuses this class's own already-shipped DamageDice override:{upgrade:true} mechanism (deadhand.one-weapon-one-answer.json). The Hardness-ignoring and resistance-ignoring clauses are unbuilt -- no rule-element key lets a Strike bypass a target's own Hardness/resistance value.
